public_rationale: This is a qualified assessment of risk with two undefined boundaries. Financial evidence could make the view more or less plausible, but would not uniquely establish when danger was imminent or when OpenAI was out of the woods. Adopting the rumor's 2024 date or treating later survival as proof would add a commitment Marcus did not make.
limitations: This does not judge the reasonableness of his financial concerns.
The financing announcement is context, not evidence of solvency or profitability.
